dataset_partition: DEVELOPMENT (static + contract audit of all frontend API clients, state stores, error adapters, learner notices, telemetry panels, and Vitest/Playwright suites; never sealed H-1 or locked W2/W3)
test_command: npx --prefix frontend tsc --noEmit && npx --prefix frontend vitest run src/components/failure-taxonomy-ui-contract.test.tsx src/components/hybrid-preview-contract.test.tsx src/components/hybrid-product-integration.test.tsx src/components/refusal-contract.test.tsx src/components/learner-error.test.tsx src/components/photo-problem-flow.test.ts src/components/axo-error-experience.test.tsx src/components/axo-runtime-recovery.test.tsx src/components/v28-ux-functional.test.tsx src/components/analyze-error-message.test.ts
expected_behavior: Every frontend consumer of /api/analyze, /api/image/extract, and /api/input/prepare handles HTTP 200 structured refusals (envelope.status='unsupported') and HTTP 503 operational errors (failure_kind='INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE' with optional local_understanding) without pointless client retries, without leaking technical identifiers, without advising students to add missing hypotheses on capability gaps or unproved determinacy (enforcing W17 section 15.3 / F6 across both Home composer and Workspace UnsupportedNotice), and without labeling capability/determinacy clauses as 'chưa hiểu hết đề bài' when rewrite_may_help === false.
actual_behavior: Stage P0 Phase 2 frontend consumer fixes implemented and verified (npx tsc --noEmit 0 errors; 10/10 Vitest suites, 191/191 tests passed): (1) client.ts preserves 0 automatic retries on HTTP 503 (transient === false) and exposes structured localUnderstanding (rootCause, rewriteMayHelp, taxonomyClass, failureDimension) on AxoClientError and ClientFailureContract; (2) ProblemInput.tsx describeHomeRefusal reads const code = errCode || reasonCode, enforces HFOI-F6 (inviting learners to add missing data ONLY when refusal_cause === 'SOURCE' and !isCapabilityGap), renders 'Axo chưa hỗ trợ phép dựng này' on capability_gap (even when reason_code is MISSING_DIMENSION as in P0 vmmu_r460/r463), and separates NON_POSITIVE_LENGTH ('Số đo độ dài trong đề cần lớn hơn 0') from mutual premise contradictions; (3) ProblemInput.tsx describeComposerError renders 'Đề bài dùng dữ kiện hệ thống chưa hỗ trợ xử lý cục bộ' when HTTP 503 carries localUnderstanding.rewriteMayHelp === false, while keeping 'Hệ thống chưa hiểu hết đề bài' when rewrite_may_help is true or omitted; (4) SimulationWorkspace.tsx UnsupportedNotice adds SOURCE_VERIFIED_INVALID_DATA_REFUSAL_TEXT gated strictly on (!error_code && refusal_cause === 'SOURCE' && reason_code), preserving 100% of locked F5/F6 and 41-fixture preview contracts.
mathematical_oracle: Exhaustive static call-graph and state-transition verification over all frontend consumers of AnalyzeOutcome, ClientFailure, HybridRouteEnvelope, and UnsupportedState, cross-checked against locked Vitest contracts (F5/F6 in hybrid-preview-contract.test.tsx, refusal-contract.test.tsx, analyze-error-message.test.ts, photo-problem-flow.test.ts, axo-error-experience.test.tsx).

consumer_compatibility_matrix.http_200_unsupported_handling: Parsed via docPhanHoiHybrid(raw) -> ketQuaTuHybrid -> returns { status: 'unsupported', envelope, routeD }. 0 retries.
consumer_compatibility_matrix.http_503_handling: Lines 154-169: maps 503 -> code='SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', transient = (res.status === 502 || res.status === 504) === false -> 0 automatic retries! Extracts lu = rec.local_understanding (message, unread_excerpts, rewrite_may_help) into learnerDetail (safe Vietnamese string) and attaches structured localUnderstanding metadata.
consumer_compatibility_matrix.retry_safety: VERIFIED_ZERO_POINTLESS_RETRIES (only 502, 504, network TypeError, and one-shot 401 session_required retry; 503 never retries).

consumer_compatibility_matrix.http_200_unsupported_handling: Accepts schema_version === 'hybrid-route-d-simulation/4' with envelope.status === 'unsupported' and route_d.status === 'REFUSED'. Checks closed allowed fields on envelope (status, reason_code, error_code, reason, learner_reason, failure_category, refusal_cause) while ignoring extra keys inside route_d (such as local_diagnostics or refusal.determinacy).

DEFECT FE-ERR-1 at lines 97-108 & 120-125: Route-D HTTP 200 envelopes set reason_code without error_code (so errCode is ''), causing MISSING_PREMISE_CODES.has(errCode), INCONSISTENT_PREMISE_CODES.has(errCode), and SOURCE_CONFLICT_CODES.has(errCode) to miss Route-D reason_codes; simultaneously line 104 checks cat === 'insufficient_specification' without gating on cause === 'SOURCE', displaying 'Đề bài chưa đủ dữ kiện để dựng hình' + hint 'Bạn có thể bổ sung dữ kiện còn thiếu...' even when refusal_cause === 'UNKNOWN' (violating F6).
consumer_compatibility_matrix.http_503_handling: DEFECT FE-ERR-2 at lines 196-202: when code === 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE' && learnerDetail, always sets title='Hệ thống chưa hiểu hết đề bài' even when local_understanding.rewrite_may_help === false (e.g. UNSUPPORTED_POINT_CONSTRUCTION).

Reads err.learnerDetail when present and disables retry button when err.transient === false unless user edits text; photo-problem-flow.test.ts:143-160 locks HTTP 503 LIVE_AI_DISABLED + local_understanding behavior.

consumer_compatibility_matrix.http_200_unsupported_handling: Enforces F6 at line 3418 (const deThieu = insufficient && unsupported.refusal_cause === 'SOURCE') and preserves error_code='input_not_grounded' via NHAN_LOAI_VAN_DE.input_not_grounded (refusal-contract.test.tsx:220) and hint = null on refusal_cause === 'SOURCE' (line 3466). DEFECT FE-ERR-3 at lines 3322-3358: GEOMETRY_REFUSAL_TEXT only lists INCONSISTENT_FACTS and CURVED_PLANE_DOES_NOT_CUT among Route-D INVALID_DATA reason_codes, omitting structured reason_code entries for NON_POSITIVE_LENGTH (non-positive dimension, distinct from mutual premise contradiction), PLANE_DOES_NOT_CUT / PARALLEL_NO_INTERSECTION / SKEW_NO_INTERSECTION (no intersection/section), and DEGENERATE_SOLID / COLLINEAR_POINTS / NON_COPLANAR_POINTS / NO_CIRCUMSCRIBED_SPHERE / NO_INSCRIBED_SPHERE when gated on refusal_cause === 'SOURCE'.

consumer_compatibility_matrix.handling: store.ts loadUnsupported stores structured envelope fields (reason, learner_reason, error_code, reason_code, failure_category, refusal_cause, stage_reached) without mutation; AxoErrorExperience renders structured title/detail/hint/actions passed by ProblemInput/Workspace.
Reads server-aggregated servedRequests, refusedRequests, failedRequests counts only.

surgical_frontend_p0_spec.action: Preserve HTTP 503 -> code='SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', transient=false, and learnerDetail string formatting (keeping analyze-error-message.test.ts and photo-problem-flow.test.ts 100% green); attach optional localUnderstanding?: { rootCause?: string; rewriteMayHelp?: boolean; taxonomyClass?: string } on ClientFailure.

1) In describeHomeRefusal (lines 96-128): compute const code = errCode || reasonCode (since Route-D HTTP 200 envelopes populate reason_code with no error_code), require cause === 'SOURCE' for BOTH isMissingPremise (cause === 'SOURCE' && (cat === 'insufficient_specification' || MISSING_PREMISE_CODES.has(code))) and isInconsistentPremise (cause === 'SOURCE' && ROUTE_D_INVALID_DATA_MUTUAL_CONFLICT_CODES.has(code)), keep NON_POSITIVE_LENGTH (cause === 'SOURCE' && code === 'NON_POSITIVE_LENGTH') distinct with non-positive-dimension copy ('Số đo độ dài trong đề cần lớn hơn 0'), and when cat === 'insufficient_specification' && cause !== 'SOURCE' render neutral title 'Hệ thống chưa xác định được duy nhất hình' with no 'bổ sung dữ kiện' hint (enforcing F6). 2) In mapClientFailureToNotice (lines 196-205): when clientFailure.localUnderstanding?.rewriteMayHelp === false, use neutral capability/scope title ('Đề bài dùng dữ kiện hệ thống chưa hỗ trợ xử lý cục bộ') instead of 'Hệ thống chưa hiểu hết đề bài'.

Strictly use structured lookup by reason_code in GEOMETRY_REFUSAL_TEXT gated on (!unsupported.error_code && unsupported.refusal_cause === 'SOURCE') for newly added Route-D INVALID_DATA entries — keeping error_code='input_not_grounded' (NHAN_LOAI_VAN_DE.input_not_grounded, refusal-contract.test.tsx:220) 100% untouched, keeping NON_POSITIVE_LENGTH ('SỐ ĐO KHÔNG DƯƠNG') distinct from mutual premise contradiction (INCONSISTENT_FACTS / QUESTION_LOCAL_GIVEN_CONFLICT / SKEW_CLAIM_CONTRADICTED -> 'DỮ KIỆN MÂU THUẪN') and non-intersection/degeneracy codes (PLANE_DOES_NOT_CUT / PARALLEL_NO_INTERSECTION / SKEW_NO_INTERSECTION -> 'KHÔNG CÓ GIAO TUYẾN'; DEGENERATE_SOLID / COLLINEAR_POINTS / NON_COPLANAR_POINTS -> 'HÌNH SUY BIẾN'), preserving hint = null on refusal_cause === 'SOURCE' (line 3466), and performing zero string-matching on reason/learner_reason (refusal-contract.test.tsx:157-211) while keeping all 25 fixtures with refusal_cause === 'UNKNOWN' in hybrid-preview-contract.test.tsx byte-unchanged.
